supplier_about_subtitle: Basic supplier data and contact information (read-only).
supplier_about_help_body: Below you will find identification, address and contact data. If something is incorrect, contact your network administrator.
supplier_about_details_hint: Address and contact data linked to your account.
read_only_hint: This is an information view (no editing).
contact_hint: Contact data is used for communication within the franchise network integration.
mode_hint: Sets which menus this device shows. The setting belongs to the tablet, not to the account.
mode_gestion_what: Dashboard and KPIs, checklists and quality control, knowledge base, complaints.
mode_production_what: Needs, workshop planning, mise en place, stock and orders.
mode_webshop_what: Opens the shop's franchisee back office: rounds, stock, assortment, B2B customers.
webshop_url_hint: Leave empty to use the address configured on the server.
webshop_shop_hint: Leave empty to use the session's shop:
webshop_shop_none: No shop in this tablet's session: this id is then required.
webshop_no_url: No back-office address is stored on this tablet.
webshop_bad_url: The stored address is not a web address (it must start with http:// or https://).
webshop_no_shop: No shop is attached to this session: the back office would not know what to show.
device_unreachable: Device details are not available right now.
settings_subtitle: This device's settings and account details.
